name: Step link
summary: A quiet way to another step, such as “Search by name instead”, “Try another provider” or “Sign in with it instead”. With back, it has an arrow that mirrors right to left.

when: Under a step's main action, for another way forward or back.

anatomy.description: Points back. Mirrors right to left. Decorative.

props.name: back
props.description: Shows a back arrow, for links that go back a step.

states.name: Back
states.description: With an arrow that mirrors right to left.

events.name: click
events.when: It's pressed. The app goes to the other step and moves focus to its heading.

accessibility.name: Its label.
screenReader: Announced as a button, because it changes the step, not the page.

guidelines: Say where it goes: “Search by name instead”.

dosAndDonts.do: Keep it under the main action.
dosAndDonts.dont: Make it look like the main action.

evidence.point: Arrows that point a direction mirror in right-to-left languages (#6).
